[[Indigo Plateau]] }} '''The Last Battle III''' (Japanese: '''最終決戦III''' ''The Last Battle III'') is the 169th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 79th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Blue}} is unable to control the front three carriages of the [[Magnet Train]]. [[Brock]] and [[Erika]] rush in to the driver's cab to help, but not even the combined {{m|Magnitude}} of Brock's six Geodude are able to stop the train. Erika soon notices that they are fast approaching a dead end, and will crash if they don't do something. Meanwhile, in the middle of the rear three carriages of the train which are heading back to the [[Indigo Plateau]], [[Falkner]], [[Bugsy]], [[Whitney]], and [[Morty]] continue to whittle down some {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s, when [[Lt. Surge]] enters to inform them about the carriage split, and how he was able to generate enough electricity to reverse the carriages' motion. He holds up a [[Great Ball]] as proof of his accomplishment. [[Misty]] gasps upon seeing the {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} inside. {{adv|Blaine}} knows that the last of the {{adv|Legendary beasts}} has found its companion. They eventually show Lt. Surge the Great Balls of two other beasts that have accepted them, and together the beasts teleport the three [[Kanto]] [[Gym Leader]]s towards the [[Indigo Plateau]], which has mostly been evacuated but {{adv|Tower duo|Ho-Oh and Lugia}} remain on the rampage. The three Gym Leaders arrive to confront the [[Masked Man]]. ==Major events== * [[Lt. Surge]] is revealed to have {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Raikou}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blue}} * {{adv|Blaine}} * [[Brock]] * [[Misty]] * [[Erika]] * [[Lt.
